meta.name: verify-form-validation
meta.description: Check that a form actually rejects bad input: the error message renders, the submit button stays disabled, and no request goes out. Use when validation logic was written but never driven, when a "required" or pattern check looks right on screen but was never proven, or when a bug report says the form submitted invalid data anyway.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证表单是否真的拦下非法输入,确认报错出现、提交按钮禁用、请求不发出去
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果表单校验逻辑已经写好,却从没真正驱动它跑一遍来证明有效
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your validation logic exists but was never actually driven to prove it works

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会驱动真实表单,确认坏输入确实被拦下:应用自己的报错有没有出现、提交按钮是否真的禁用、有没有请求发出去。
howto.when: 当校验逻辑写好了却从没被驱动过、required 或 pattern 检查看着对但没被证明过,或缺陷报告说表单提交了无效数据时触发。

say.text: 给这个表单填一个无效值,确认报错出现、提交按钮禁用
say.note: Reticle 会驱动真实表单核对三处失败点

say.text: 试着点一下那个禁用的提交按钮,确认没有请求发出去
say.note: 用于识破只靠 CSS 假装禁用的按钮

say.text: 把值改正确,确认报错消失、提交按钮重新可用
say.note: 验证拒绝是有条件的,不是永久性的

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the real form to confirm bad input is actually rejected: the app's own error renders, the submit button stays disabled, and no request goes out.
howto.when_en: Use when validation logic was written but never driven, when a required or pattern check looks right but never proven, or when a bug report says the form submitted invalid data.

say_en.text: Fill this form with an invalid value; check the error and disabled submit
say_en.note: Drives the real form and checks three failure points

say_en.text: Try clicking that disabled submit button and confirm no request fires
Correct the value and confirm the error clears and submit re-enables
say_en.note: Checks the rejection is conditional, not permanent
